blocks.text: Homes for Sale in Sunnyside Park, South Surrey

parts.t: Welcome to Sunnyside Park Surrey — a family-friendly South Surrey neighbourhood known for its parks, schools, and convenient access to White Rock and major commuter routes. Browse detached homes, townhomes, condos, and new listings updated in real time. If you’re buying or selling in Sunnyside Park Surrey, South Surrey REALTOR® Jared Gibbons can walk you through recent sales and what to check on a home. Explore
For Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest, local schools and the Semiahmoo Town Centre plan, see my

Sunnyside Park Surrey is the Paragon (MLS) name for the established part of South Surrey around 148 Street, 152 Street, 20 Avenue and 24 Avenue, just north of the Semiahmoo Town Centre. The City uses the name Sunnyside for Bakerview Park and Sunnyside Community Hall on 154 Street. Don't mix it up with Sunnyside Heights, which is a separate Grandview Heights plan area further east. Homes here are mainly houses, with Semiahmoo Secondary, the recreation centre, the library and Semiahmoo Shopping Centre all close by.
Local Guide · 148 St to 154 St & 20 Ave to 24 Ave

This is one of the handiest parts of South Surrey for everyday life. Many errands are a short walk or drive away. You've got the Semiahmoo Trail, Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest and Bakerview Park nearby, and the shops on 152 Street just to the south.

blocks.text: What the name means Sunnyside Park vs. Sunnyside Heights

parts.t: Sunnyside Park is the Paragon name. The City of Surrey uses "Sunnyside" for park and hall facilities in this part of South Surrey. It uses "Sunnyside Heights" for a separate neighbourhood plan area inside
, bordered by 168 Street, 24 Avenue and the Highway 99 corridor. The two are not the same place. There is no City boundary map for the Paragon sub-area.

blocks.text: Roads and getting around 148 St, 152 St, 20 Ave, 24 Ave & Route 321

parts.t: 148 Street, 152 Street, 20 Avenue, 24 Avenue and King George Boulevard serve the area. City planning material notes the Semiahmoo Trail crossing at 148 Street and a pedestrian overpass on King George. For transit, route 321 runs on King George Boulevard and 152 Street between Surrey Central Station and White Rock Centre. Other routes on individual streets aren't confirmed.

blocks.text: Schools Semiahmoo Secondary, Jessie Lee & H.T. Thrift

parts.t: Semiahmoo Secondary, at 1785 148 Street, is in or right beside the area. Jessie Lee Elementary, at 2064 154 Street, is the elementary school for homes facing Sunnyside Park (City of Surrey planning report). On the Surrey Schools boundary map, the area splits at 152 Street: east of 152 Street is Jessie Lee Elementary and Earl Marriott Secondary, and west of it is H.T. Thrift Elementary (1739 148 Street) and Semiahmoo Secondary.

blocks.text: Parks, trails and recreation Bakerview Park, Urban Forest & Rec Centre

parts.t: Bakerview Park, at 1845 154 Street, is home to Sunnyside Community Hall, with a garden, a playground, baseball diamonds and a soccer field. Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest and the Semiahmoo Trail are close by for walks under the trees. The South Surrey Recreation & Arts Centre is at 14601 20 Avenue, and the Semiahmoo Library is at 1815 152 Street.

blocks.text: Shopping Semiahmoo Shopping Centre & Urgent Care

parts.t: Semiahmoo Shopping Centre, at 1711 152 Street, is the main centre beside the area. The South Surrey Urgent and Primary Care Centre is inside the shopping centre, which is handy for families. Its anchors include Save-On-Foods, Shoppers Drug Mart, Dollarama and Winners (First Capital, owner source).

blocks.text: Housing and zoning Single-family lots, FBSA & Odyssey

parts.t: Homes here are mostly houses under Surrey's small-scale multi-unit housing zones. Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000 assigns every lot a zone, which you can check in the City's COSMOS map. Under the City's rules, lots under 280 m² can usually have up to 3 units and larger lots up to 4. Eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop can have up to 6. With route 321 on King George Boulevard and 152 Street, some lots here may be in a Frequent Bus Stop Area, so check COSMOS. Named condo and townhome buildings aren't confirmed on an official or developer source yet. Odyssey by Forge Properties is two four-storey apartment buildings at 2620 152 Street and 2635 King George Boulevard (City of Surrey planning report PLR_7921-0369-00).

blocks.text: Plans nearby Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan & KGB BRT

parts.t: The Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan borders this sub-area. It covers 16 Avenue to 24 Avenue, from Martin Drive to Earl Marriott Secondary, and has been updated to line up with King George Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit and the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan. Sunnyside Heights is a separate plan area within Grandview Heights, bordered to the south by the Fergus Watershed Biodiversity Preserve. The
is close by, and its page covers the BRT plans.

blocks.text: Buying a strata home here Bylaws, fees, Form B & Form F

parts.t: If you're looking at a condo or townhome, the Province's strata pages are a good place to start. They cover the Strata Property Act, bylaws and rules, strata fees and special levies, and the Form B and Form F documents you'll review. Strata plans and bylaws are filed at the Land Title Office. parts.t: Floodplain and ALR status for a specific lot here aren't confirmed. Check City flood information and the Agricultural Land Commission's maps by parcel.
Is Sunnyside Park the same as Sunnyside Heights?
No. Sunnyside Heights is a separate Grandview Heights plan area by 168 Street and 24 Avenue. Sunnyside Park's facilities, Bakerview Park and Sunnyside Community Hall, are on 154 Street.

Semiahmoo Secondary at 1785 148 Street. Check the School Locator for the catchment of a specific address. East of 152 Street, the boundary map shows Jessie Lee Elementary and Earl Marriott Secondary. West of it, H.T. Thrift Elementary and Semiahmoo Secondary.
Sunnyside Community Hall, a garden, a playground, baseball diamonds and a soccer field, at 1845 154 Street.
How many units can a house lot hold?
Under Surrey's multi-unit rules, usually up to 3 on lots under 280 m², up to 4 on larger lots, and up to 6 on eligible lots near a frequent bus stop.
Route 321, on King George Boulevard and 152 Street, between Surrey Central Station and White Rock Centre.
The South Surrey Urgent and Primary Care Centre is inside Semiahmoo Shopping Centre, at 120-1711 152 Street. Peace Arch Hospital in White Rock is the nearest hospital.
